findings.description: The inline policy grants wildcard actions (ec2:*, s3:*, lambda:*, cloudwatch:*) on all resources ("Resource": "*"), violating least privilege and allowing this IAM user to perform virtually any action on these services, including privilege escalation and data exfiltration.
A long-lived IAM access key is created for a user with excessive permissions, increasing the risk of credential leakage and misuse rather than using short-lived roles or scoped-down permissions.

findings.issue_category: standing IAM user with broad access
findings.description: Creating a standalone IAM user (rather than a role) attached to an overly permissive policy establishes a persistent, highly privileged identity that increases attack surface and blast radius if compromised.
